Life-changing: AI handles work that genuinely saves time or unlocks new capabilities.

Actually useful: AI helps you think, learn, or handle repetitive tasks without replacing your judgment.

Please do it yourself: Anything where the human part is the whole point — like dating, hiring decisions, or anything that requires real judgment.

The goal isn’t to use AI for everything.

If your company is on the journey to becoming AI-native, start with this 30-day exercise.

Week 1: Identify the problem.
Find a specific workflow or problem where AI could genuinely create value. Don’t start with the technology. Start with what is broken, repetitive or inefficient.

Week 2: Teach AI the solution.
Show AI how the problem is solved today. Give it the context, examples, processes and expertise it needs to understand what a good solution looks like.

Week 3: Build a prototype.
Use vibe coding and AI tools to create a quick prototype. This is not the production product. The goal is to test whether the idea actually works.

Week 4: Measure the ROI.
Put the prototype in the hands of real users. Measure time saved, cost saved, output improved or revenue generated.

At the end of 30 days, you should know whether this AI use case is actually worth building.

If the ROI makes sense, that’s when you take the validated prototype to ALTRD, or another AI implementation company, and get it built production-ready.

You save a lot of time and implementation cost because you bring deep knowledge of your business and its problems, while the implementation partner brings the AI and engineering expertise required to scale the solution.

Find the problem → Teach → Prototype → Prove ROI → Build for production.
